get.summary:
Looks up a shipment (either a native CLM shipment or a KonsHub shipment) by id and returns a reduced,
external-facing representation of it. This is an integration endpoint for external systems: it
internally forwards the lookup, via an impersonated HTTP call, to the internal
`ShipmentQuery/GetShipmentForExternal` endpoint and relays its response.

post.summary:
Creates a new incident/finding against a CLM, KonsHub, or equipment-booking shipment, links it to the
shipment, and recalculates the shipment's incident counts. A background command is queued afterwards
to generate thumbnails for the incident's attached files, and, if the shipment is already completed,
to trigger PDF regeneration.

Soft-deletes an incident by marking it as deleted (`IsMarkedToDelete`) rather than physically
removing it, then recalculates the owning shipment's incident counts to exclude it.
post.description:
Validation requires a non-empty `ItemId` that resolves to an incident which exists and has not
already been marked as deleted.

post.summary:
Updates the remark, attached files, and finding type of an existing incident, then recalculates the
owning shipment's incident counts and re-queues thumbnail generation for the updated files.
post.description:
Validation rejects the request unless the incident exists and the calling user is the same user who
originally created the incident.

post.summary:
Retrieves the full detail of a single incident/finding by its item id, including who created it
and, for the requesting user, whether they are permitted to update or delete it (granted only when
the current user is the incident's creator).

Retrieves all non-deleted incidents/findings raised against a specific shipment, enriched with
each incident's creator display name and, where photos are attached, a thumbnail URL for the
first photo.

Retrieves all non-deleted incidents/findings linked to a given connection (e.g. a KonsHub or
equipment-booking connection grouping shipments), enriched with each incident's creator display
name and, where photos are attached, a thumbnail URL for the first photo.

Registers an uploaded lean document (an Excel workbook used to bulk import/refresh lean cards) for a
project/site if it does not already exist, then queues it for background processing that parses the
workbook and creates or updates the corresponding lean cards.

Creates a new lean card (working package) for a project/site, assigning it to a sender and recipient
team, computing its initial status, and setting the access-control roles that determine who can read or
update it. Also queues background jobs to refresh site-structure and team grouping counts.

Updates an existing lean card's location (building/floor/laydown area), comment, dates, archived flag,
volume, and estimated transport unit; recalculates its status; and queues background jobs to re-sync
site-structure and team grouping counts using the old and new values.

Finalizes the working-package import: creates the lean document record for the uploaded file if one
does not already exist, then queues a background command that creates or updates the actual lean cards
from the previously mapped Excel data.

Saves the user-selected mapping between Excel columns and lean card fields (activity id, date format,
sender/recipient team) for a previously uploaded working-package file, then queues background building
of a preview of the resulting working packages by matching rows against existing teams and lean cards,
notifying the uploading user of the outcome.

Sends an email notification, in each recipient's preferred language, to the members of a lean card's
(working package's) sender team informing them that its start/end dates have changed.

Queues the initial background processing of an uploaded working-package Excel file: reading the
selected sheet, parsing its rows/columns into a temporary upload record, and notifying the uploading
user once processing completes, in preparation for the header-mapping step.

Checks whether an activity id (lean card name) is still available for a given sender team, i.e. no
existing, non-deleted lean card for that team already uses it.

get.summary:
Retrieves the downloadable sample Excel template used for bulk working-package import, selecting the
file variant based on the requested (or current user's) language and, if provided, whether the role is a
vendor role.

post.summary:
Retrieves the lean cards (working packages) eligible to be added to a shipment for a site, restricted to
the requesting user's team assignments unless they are an admin, optionally scoped to a specific
building/floor, sender team, recipient team, or single working-package grouping, and split into those
due by the booking date versus all matches.

Retrieves a preview of the working packages that would be created or updated from a previously mapped
working-package Excel file, split into successfully matched rows and faulty rows - used to let the user
review results before committing the import.

Retrieves the parsed sheet headers, detected date formats, any previously saved header mapping, and (for
vendor uploaders) the teams they may assign the import to, for a previously uploaded working-package
Excel file - used to render the header-mapping step of the import wizard.

Retrieves a paged set of lean cards (working packages) for a site within a date range, formatted for
display on a Gantt chart, restricted to the requesting user's vendor teams unless they hold an
admin/project/site-level role.

Retrieves a paged, status-filtered list of lean cards (working packages) for a site, restricted to the
teams the requesting user has vendor access to unless they hold an admin/project/site-level role, sorted
according to the requested status (e.g. by dates for active/overdue/pending, by last update for
completed).

Retrieves the count of lean cards (working packages) for a site broken down by status (overdue, active,
pending, completed), restricted to the requesting user's vendor teams unless they hold an
admin/project/site-level role.

Toggles a handover's status between InProgress and Paused, appending a new handover event capturing the
note and photos for the change, and updates the parent shipment's aggregated handover status. Pausing
also queues a background job to generate thumbnails for the responsible-person photos of that event.

Marks a handover as Completed: appends a completion event, stores the final material/responsible-person
photos and note, computes the total time spent by summing the durations between paired handover events,
optionally attaches the responsible person resolved from a QR-code scan, updates the parent shipment's
aggregated handover status (triggering PDF regeneration if the shipment itself is now complete), and
queues a background job to generate thumbnails for the final photos.

Creates a new material handover for a CLM or Konshub shipment, snapshotting the shipment's bookable
equipment and assigning a sequential handover number, then updates the shipment's aggregated handover
status/counters and queues a background job to generate thumbnails for the uploaded material photos.

Looks up the site of the given handover and returns the active bookable site equipment for that site,
excluding equipment that has already been added as unplanned equipment to that handover, for use when
creating a new unplanned equipment entry.

Returns the details (including full event history) of the Konshub-type material handover associated
with the given shipment.

Returns the unplanned equipment usage recorded for a shipment, and — only when the shipment is of type
CLM — also the planned bookable equipment usage from the shipment's equipment timeline (excluding adhoc
equipment).

Returns all material handover records created for the given shipment, regardless of their status, as
summary DTOs.

Returns the full details of a single material handover, including its complete event history and the
planned/unplanned equipment usage joined against the shipment's equipment bookings.

Returns material handover summaries for a site filtered by status. When filtering for Completed
handovers, results are additionally restricted to those last updated within the given date range.
Retrieves the intraday, interval-based weather breakdown stored for a specific site on a specific calendar day.
Retrieves the daily Meteomatics weather records (temperature, min/max temperature, wind speed, weather symbol) stored for a site within a date range.
Determines whether a site has UpEdge smart-flow devices configured, i.e. whether the recommendation/automation flow is available for that site.
Adds a new comment to a shipment, attributed to the current user.

Transitions a shipment to a new status (approved, waiting/ongoing/unloading, rejected/withdrawn, cancelled at transit, or completed), updates grouping counts, and triggers background processing (e.g. notifications) for the status change.
Deletes an existing shipment comment.

Discards a shipment: if the shipment is still an in-progress wizard draft it is deleted entirely; if it has already been submitted, only its pending edit draft (and smart-wizard draft) is cleared, leaving the submitted shipment intact.
Queues generation of the cockpit daily report PDF (scheduled shipments, equipment, and ad-hoc shipment summaries) for background processing; once generated, the requesting user is notified.

Requests (and returns, if already available) the generated PDF report for a shipment in the given language; if no PDF has been generated yet, this queues background PDF generation and returns immediately without a URL.

Saves the booking date step of the shipment wizard: for a shipment still being created it applies the booking date, express-shipment flag, and lean card directly; for an already-submitted shipment being edited, the change is stored as a pending draft.

Saves the material-selection step of the shipment wizard: for a shipment still being created this sets its materials and recipient team directly; for an already-submitted shipment being edited, the change is stored as a pending draft rather than applied immediately.

Saves the final "other info" step of the shipment wizard (on-site responsible person, sustainability/vehicle info, etc.), finalizing the shipment: persists the additional responsible persons and remaining shipment details, then triggers a background command to complete post-save processing.

Saves the timeslot step of the shipment wizard: resolves the selected zone (and its waiting area, if any), then for a shipment still being created applies the schedule window and equipment reservations directly, or for an already-submitted shipment being edited, stores the change as a pending draft.

Saves the unloading/vehicle step of the shipment wizard: for a shipment still being created it sets the selected vehicle's name, type, ID, and key directly on the shipment; for an already-submitted shipment being edited, the change is stored as a pending draft.
Queues a background job to notify the shipment's recipient that a shipment has been requested, sending the "shipment requested" email in every supported language once the shipment is found.
Updates the text of an existing shipment comment.

Creates or updates an ad-hoc (walk-in, non-wizard) shipment: if a shipment with the given ID already exists it is updated, otherwise a new one is created and a background command is queued to finish processing it (e.g. thumbnail generation, notifications).

Creates, updates, or removes a team's saved sustainability address: marking an address as not-favourite deletes it, otherwise the address (identified by item ID) is updated if it already exists or created new for the given team.

Builds the cockpit's date-wise dashboard charts for a site and date: unloading zone activity, bookable equipment utilization, non-bookable equipment utilization, and the count of approved shipments, all computed concurrently.

Builds the weekly shipment count grid for a site's active unloading zones: for each zone and each day in the requested week, calculates scheduled usage against availability and the resulting under-utilization percentage, plus a combined total across all zones.

Builds the weekly shipment utilization grid for a site's active unloading zones: for each zone and each day in the requested week, aggregates shipment duration against availability and calculates the resulting under-utilization percentage, plus a combined total across all zones.

Loads the reference data needed to create an ad-hoc shipment for a site: the site's role-filtered materials, active (non-requested, non-deleted) vendor teams, active non-bookable site equipment, and the site's currently active unloading zones.

get.summary: Retrieves the audit/event log history for a given item (shipment or a related connected entity), ordered chronologically.

post.summary: Loads the material-selection step data for the shipment wizard for a given site: the current user's favorite materials, materials filtered by the sender CLM team, the valid CLM teams for the site/project (filtered by team type and tags), and the full material-unit dictionary, all resolved concurrently.
Retrieves a single shipment by its identifier.
Retrieves all comments posted on a shipment, enriched with the display information of the commenters.
Determines whether a shipment has bookable equipment that must be checked before it can be marked complete, based on its equipment timeline records in an approved or un-approved state.
Retrieves a shipment (native CLM or KonsHub-linked) in the reduced format intended for external consumers.
post.description: Throws an System.ArgumentException if no shipment with the given ID exists in either source.

post.summary: Retrieves the details of a shipment grouping (sender/recipient team, building/floor site structure, or working package), based on the requested grouping type.

Returns a paged list of a site's shipments (filtered by status and optional schedule date range) together with the sender team's display info and, if one has already been generated, the URL of the shipment's PDF report in the requested language.
Returns a paged list of previously generated shipment PDF reports for a site.
Returns the shipments that belong to a given grouping (sender/recipient team, building/floor site structure, or working package).

Computes shipment counts for the cockpit list view broken down by status bucket (open, approved, completed, cancelled/rejected) for a site, applying the same field filters and search keys as the list view, with each bucket count computed concurrently.
Returns a filtered, ordered, paged list of shipments for the cockpit weekly view, applying the requested schedule date range, status, unloading zone, and shipment ID filters.

Returns a filtered, searched, ordered, and paged list of shipments for the cockpit list view, scoped to the site, requested statuses, and the current user's specific team visibility, with additional field filters and free-text search applied.
Returns a paged list of valid shipments for a site together with their associated event log entries.

Returns the bookable dates for a site within a given month/year, based on booking prerequisites that have at least one zone configured, clipped to the project site's start/end dates and restricted to today or later.

Resolves which of the requested equipment IDs are non-bookable equipment, checks whether they have any capacity on the booking date (returning a full-day "unavailable" slot if not), and otherwise queries capacity-based booked slots from the calendar service, excluding the shipment's own existing reservation window when updating an existing shipment.

Given a site, date, and direction (next/previous), searches a +/-10 day window of bookable dates, bounded by the project site's start/end dates, and returns the nearest available date in that direction.

Resolves the bookable timeslot grid for a site and date (optionally restricted to a specific vehicle): finds bookable zones, then concurrently fetches calendar reservations, self non-bookable equipment, and waiting areas to build the equipment-to-zone/timeslot grid.

Loads the unloading step data for the shipment wizard for a given site and booking date: finds the booking prerequisite for that date, resolves its unloading zones, the "self vehicle" mapping, and the site's checked/site-map documents.
Retrieves the combined sustainability configuration for a team: its saved sustainability addresses and the list of mapped vehicles available for sustainability tracking.
Retrieves the saved sustainability addresses (e.g. delivery/pickup locations used for sustainability distance tracking) configured for a team.
Searches for shipments matching the given search criteria across both KonsHub-linked shipments and native CLM shipments for the site, scoped to the teams the current user is a member of.

Creates a new site equipment booking submitted from the mobile app in a single call, covering
booking date/slots, transport info, and other info (responsible persons, photos), then queues a
background command that finalizes the booking (timeline creation and approval notifications).

Creates a new site equipment master record (creating its calendar reservation object and, if bookable,
publishing an availability-set command) or updates an existing one (recreating/updating its reservation
object and queuing a background command to refresh its zone attachment).

Permanently deletes a site equipment record and queues background commands to remove its zone attachment
and, for bookable equipment, its booking prerequisites.

Soft-deletes an equipment booking comment by marking it as deleted (it is excluded from subsequent reads
but not physically removed).

Soft-deletes an unplanned equipment usage record (marks it as deleted), removes its associated timeline
entry, and logs an event.

Discards an in-progress site equipment booking: permanently deletes it if it is still a drafted (not yet
finalized) booking, or clears its in-progress draft data if it is an existing valid booking.

Adds a new comment to a site equipment booking, or edits an existing comment's text when
Commands.EquipmentBookingCommentSaveCommand.ItemId matches an existing comment.

Saves the booking-date step of a site equipment booking (booking date, weather info, time slots).
Creates a brand-new booking with status `UnApproved` when none exists yet for the given id, or
updates the existing booking's (or draft's) booking info otherwise.

Saves the "other info" step of a site equipment booking (creator/on-site responsible persons, photos,
documents, comment). Depending on whether the booking is still being drafted or already exists, this
finalizes creation (assigning a booking number and queuing the create-background command) or updates its
draft (queuing the update-background command); it also re-validates the calendar slot reservation.

Saves the transport-info step of a site equipment booking (building/floor location, transport unit
quantity, recipient team, material comment, price per unit) onto the booking record or its draft.

Queues a background command that sends a "booking requested" reminder email (in every supported language)
for a still-open (unapproved) site equipment booking; the command is placed directly on the message queue
and this endpoint returns immediately without waiting for the email to be sent.

Updates an existing site equipment booking's booking/transport/other info from the mobile app,
re-validating and re-creating the calendar slot reservation, then queues a background command that
updates the timeline and sends the relevant status-change notifications.
Activates or deactivates an existing site equipment record by toggling its `Active` flag.

Transitions a site equipment booking to a new status (e.g. approve, reject, withdraw, cancel, complete),
updates its timeline entry, and queues a background command that either completes the linked equipment
timeline (calculating actual usage/price and freeing up slots, when completing) or performs the
corresponding status-change side effects such as sending notification emails.

Creates a new unplanned equipment usage record attached to a material handover, or updates an existing
one's usage/price/slot data. On create it also (re)builds the equipment's timeline entry, assigns a
booking number, and logs an event; the same happens for updates.

Returns all non-deleted comments for a given site equipment booking, enriched with the display
information of the persons who created them.

Returns the set of pre-configured bookable dates (booking prerequisites) for a given site, equipment, and
month/year, restricted to dates that fall within the site's active date range and are not in the past.

Returns all site equipment for a site, split into bookable and non-bookable groups, formatted for the
equipment management grid view.

Returns a single equipment timeline entry (Selise.Ecap.Entities.PrimaryEntities.SmartCity.Clm.ClmSiteEquipmentTimeline) by its item id, used to
view the full detail of one equipment booking/timeline record.

Returns a paged, filtered, searched, and sorted list of equipment timeline entries for a site (used by the
cockpit equipment list view), applying status/date-range/recipient-team/equipment/annotation filters and
restricting visibility for vendor-team roles to their own team's entries.

Returns equipment timeline counts for a site broken down by open, approved, completed, and
cancelled-or-rejected status groups, applying the same filters and vendor-role visibility restrictions as
the equipment timeline list view.

Saves step 1 of the Smart Shipment wizard: the booking date, lean card and weather/timezone context.
If no shipment exists yet for the given `ShipmentId`, creates a new draft shipment (status
UnApproved) linked to the lean card's site; otherwise updates the booking-date fields on the existing
shipment (or on its smart-draft, if the shipment is already a valid, non-draft shipment).

Saves step 2 of the Smart Shipment wizard: the selected unloading zone, delivery time slots and the
bookable/non-bookable equipment associated with the shipment. Resolves the full zone (and its waiting
area, if any) and applies the schedule to the shipment directly, or to its smart-draft if the shipment
already exists as a valid (non-draft) shipment.

Saves step 4 of the Smart Shipment wizard: the delivery materials and drop-off details (building,
floor, laydown area, recipient team) for the shipment. For a new (drafted) shipment this persists the
material lines to the shipment and saves each `ShipmentMaterial` individually; for an existing
shipment it stores the material info on the shipment's smart-draft instead.

Saves the final step of the Smart Shipment wizard: responsible persons, shipment photos/documents,
comment and sustainability info, and finalizes the shipment. Validation reserves the unloading-zone
timeslot and any bookable/non-bookable equipment via the calendar service (rolling back reservations on
failure). On success, promotes the draft/smart-draft into the real shipment: for an update it applies
the requested status change (when `HasAction` is set), refreshes material handovers and updates
grouping counts; for a new shipment it assigns a shipment number and updates grouping counts. In both
cases a background command describing the change is recorded (as a pending `ClmCommand`) and sent
to the processing queue to actually create/update the shipment downstream.

Saves step 3 of the Smart Shipment wizard: the unloading vehicle details for the shipment's booking
date. Applies the vehicle information to the shipment directly, or to its smart-draft if the shipment
already exists as a valid (non-draft) shipment.

Computes recommended, conflict-free delivery time slots for a shipment at a given unloading zone.
Builds a graph of the site's unloading points and, for each candidate date (selected day and, depending
on `DateType`, surrounding days), derives available time windows sized to `BookingDuration` by
filtering out windows that conflict with other shipments, with bookable-equipment reservations/moving
equipment, with non-bookable/site equipment capacity bookings, or that would break a valid entry/exit
path through the unloading-point graph for this or other shipments.

Retrieves the data needed for the "Unloading" step of the Smart Shipment wizard for a given site and
booking date. Looks up the site's booking prerequisites for that date to determine the relevant
unloading zones, then returns the mapped "self" vehicle option together with the site's checked/site-map
documents (most recently updated first). Returns an empty step response if no booking prerequisites
exist for the site/date.

get.summary:
Diagnostic endpoint that reports the currently configured super-admin user identity/credential values,
read both from application configuration and from environment variables, to help verify deployment
configuration.

post.summary:
Enqueues the same kind of shipment data-processing command onto the background message queue instead
of running it in-process, so it is picked up and executed asynchronously by the queue consumer.

Runs a named shipment data-processing routine synchronously, in-process, for diagnostic/manual use.
The command is dispatched to `ShipmentDataProcessorCommandHandler`, which uses reflection to
invoke the method named by `ProcessName` on the shipment data processor service.

Validates and completes a site-equipment timeline entry: records the completion amount, optionally frees up any remaining reserved calendar slots for the equipment, updates the related shipment/site-equipment booking, and sends a booking-completed notification email in every supported language.

Queues an asynchronous request to build an Excel export of the site-equipment timeline, filtered by site, status, date range, team/equipment ids and search keys, and returns immediately without waiting for the report to be generated.

Queues an asynchronous request to build an Excel export of the shipment list view (UP timeline), filtered by site, status, schedule date range and sender/recipient teams, and returns immediately without waiting for the report to be generated.

Returns the day-wise timeline of active site-equipment bookings at a site within a date range (excluding self-unloading equipment and ad-hoc entries), together with the available time-range configuration for the requested day, computed from the site's unloading zones and bookable equipment.

Returns the day-wise timeline of active (non-withdrawn) shipments scheduled at a site within a date range, split into regular and ad-hoc shipments, together with the site's configured available time-range for the requested day of week.
Returns the day-wise timeline for a single shipment identified by its id.

Returns the day-wise timeline of active (non-withdrawn) shipments assigned to a site's unloading-zone waiting areas within a schedule date range, split into regular and ad-hoc shipments, together with the available time-range configuration for the requested day of week.

Saves a new "equipment view" cockpit filter (site, recipient teams, bookable/non-bookable equipment and
annotation flags) for the current user.

Saves a new "weekly view" cockpit filter (site, sender/recipient teams, moving/unloading equipment and
annotation flags) for the current user.
Removes an existing "equipment view" cockpit filter belonging to the current user.
Removes an existing "weekly view" cockpit filter belonging to the current user.
Adds or removes a material from the current user's favorite materials list for a given site.

Retrieves the data needed to render the cockpit equipment view for a site: recipient teams,
bookable and non-bookable equipment (filtered by availability for the requested schedule window), and
the current user's saved equipment-view filters for that site.

Retrieves the data needed to render the cockpit weekly view for a site: sender/recipient teams,
unloading and moving equipment (filtered by availability for the requested schedule window), and the
current user's saved weekly-view filters for that site.
